verdict.rationale: Self-hosting an open-source scraper is a fair question for a web-scraping API, since comparable products offer it. Every item in the pack describes Context.dev only as a hosted API reached through API keys, SDKs, a CLI and a hosted MCP endpoint. Nothing mentions an open-source release, a public repository or a self-hosted deployment option.

support.subject: As a developer, I can self-host an open-source version of the scraper instead of relying on a hosted cloud service
